label: Requirement 2: every mechanism must be SHOWN to change at least one decision BEFORE it is scored. Seed 4, 300 s, 50:50, dry run, against builder-default.

byte_identity.result: BYTE-IDENTICAL against TWO bases at TWO sizes

pairs.builder-default vs b7-edf-feasibility: 0 differing of 2114 rows at n=8 and 0 of 3939 at n=16
pairs.builder-acfcfs vs always-cloud-fcfs: 0 differing of 2114 rows at n=8 and 0 of 3939 at n=16

byte_identity.uses_h_trap: uses_h and h_s were compared explicitly and the coordinator-derived h_s was compared too, since coordinator.py:124 reads h_s only when uses_h is true and a getattr default can make a one-base proof pass by coincidence
byte_identity.note: the arm name is recorded on every decision row, so comparing it would report every row as differing; excluding it is a reader correction, not a relaxation

null_classification.builder-s1-feasible: UNEXERCISED. Counters fire (8,039 streams held at n=32) yet no decision differs, so every held stream had no instant due; a local StreamAction only matters when an instant is pending.
null_classification.builder-s1-fairshare: UNEXERCISED, same as above, with fairshare_held equal to sh_held so the fair-share test never excluded a stream that would otherwise have been released.
null_classification.builder-s2-all: UNEXERCISED. Every recall is already feasible under the default, so admitting all coincides with admitting the feasible.
null_classification.builder-s2-value: UNEXERCISED, and this MATCHES THE PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION that a value test imitating a cost-blind and risk-blind objective would admit everything and behave like all.
null_classification.builder-s4-llf: CANCELLED BY GEOMETRY. Laxity changes the ORDER of candidates, and with no binding release budget nothing is truncated, so order cannot change which streams are released.
null_classification.builder-s6-decline: UNEXERCISED. No REJECT arises under the default at these cells, so the branch that would turn it into DEVICE never executes.

size_dependence.finding: builder-s1-lateness is INERT at 16 devices and MOVES at 32 (3,473 decisions, 787 throttle periods)
size_dependence.consequence: mechanism eligibility is size dependent, so a screen must establish it per size rather than once

scope_note: Requirement 3 scoring can legitimately cover only the eligible set. Scoring an inert mechanism would report an ABSENT LINK as a negative, which CLAUDE.md Step 2 forbids.
